SELECT b.id, b.book_name, b.author, b.isbn, b.publisher, b.category_id, c.category_name, b.price, b.stock, b.status, b.create_time, b.update_time, b.is_deleted, r.id AS record_id, r.borrower_name, r.borrower_no, r.borrow_date, r.due_date, r.return_date, r.status AS record_status, r.remark FROM book b LEFT JOIN book_category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN borrow_record r ON r.book_id = b.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.borrow_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (book_name, author, isbn, publisher, category_id, price, stock, status) VALUES (#{bookName}, #{author}, #{isbn}, #{publisher}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET book_name = #{bookName}, author = #{author}, isbn = #{isbn}, publisher = #{publisher}, category_id = #{categoryId}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE book SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE book SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND stock > 0 AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE book SET stock = stock + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE book SET stock = stock + #{count} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
